title: Settings
description: Manage the site appearance, player import/export, backups, access and system tools.

siteIdentity.title: Name, region and footer
siteIdentity.description: Change the site name, brand text, region number and name, and footer content.
siteIdentity.ownerOnly: Editing is available to the Owner only.

identity.title: Main site details
identity.description: These values are used in the site header, browser-tab title and region information.

footer.title: Footer content
footer.description: Configure separate footer text for each supported site language.
footer.languageHelp: JSON translations are shown by default. Only changed fields are saved as overrides in D1. An empty field falls back to its default text after saving. Ukrainian and English are edited separately.
footer.restoreHelp: Restore the selected language from the JSON translations. Save to apply the change.
footer.restoreNotice: Default text restored in the draft. Click “Save changes” to apply.

help.siteName: Used in the browser-tab title and SEO title.
help.brandText: Displayed in the site header and footer.

modal.title: Site settings
modal.subtitle: Change the main name, region and footer content without editing code.
modal.footerHint: Changes are applied immediately after saving.

unsaved.title: Discard unsaved changes?
unsaved.message: You have changed site settings or footer text. Closing this window now will discard those changes.

import.title: Import players
import.description: Import only into the current cycle player table from XLSX, XLS or CSV.
import.fixBeforeImport: Fix file errors and duplicates before importing.

errors.readFile: Could not read the file. Check the XLSX/XLS/CSV format.
errors.emptyFile: The file contains no player rows.
errors.importFailed: Import failed. Do not assume the data was imported; check the Worker and file.
errors.duplicateExisting: this nickname already exists in the current cycle
errors.duplicateFile: this nickname is duplicated in the file

invalidField.captain: unknown captain value — choose Yes/No manually
invalidField.readyAttack: unknown readiness value — choose Yes/No manually

errors.saveDraftFailed: Could not save the local import draft.

mapping.cardHint: After choosing a file, a mapping window opens so every Excel column can be matched to a player field.
mapping.title: Player import settings
mapping.subtitle: File: {{file}}. Choose which columns match the site fields.
mapping.fieldsText: The site field is on the left and the uploaded column is on the right. Unused columns can be added as extra player fields.
mapping.unknownText: If the file has information that does not exist on the site yet, add that column as an extra player field.
mapping.previewText: Values are normalized before import: Tier 10 → T10, первая половина / 1st shift → shift1, вторая половина / 2nd shift → shift2, оба подходят / both are suitable → Any shift.

destination.title: Where to prepare players
destination.text: It is recommended to save the file to a local draft first, review the values, and only then move players into the current cycle.
destination.stagingText: Nothing is written to the database. You can fix mappings and continue later.
destination.currentText: Write players directly to the active cycle. Available only when there are no errors or duplicates.
destination.draftWithErrors: The draft can be saved even with errors. These rows will not be written to the database.

draft.title: Local import draft
draft.saved: Saved {{count}} rows to the local draft.
draft.help: The draft is stored only in this browser. To add players to the database and site tables, open “Player table” → “Local table” and press “Move”.

valueMapping.title: Value mapping
valueMapping.text: If the site does not recognize a troop type, tier, shift, captain or readiness value, choose the correct value manually. Unknown values are no longer silently converted to “No”.

modal.title: Export settings
modal.subtitle: Choose which player-table fields should be included in Excel.

backup.title: Backups
backup.description: Download a full region backup to your computer or restore the site from a JSON file.
backup.ownerOnly: Creating and restoring full backups is available to the Owner only.
backup.note: The backup is not stored in the database; it is a local JSON file. Users and roles are not included.

errors.invalidFile: This is not a supported Wasteland backup file.
errors.restore: Could not restore the backup. Do not assume the current data was fully restored.

restoreModal.title: Restore backup
restoreModal.subtitle: Current region data will be replaced with data from the selected file.
restoreModal.warningText: Before restore, the system automatically downloads an emergency backup of the current state. Firebase Auth and adminUsers are unchanged. All previously created secret player-table and final-plan links will be revoked. Create fresh links after restoring.
restoreModal.phraseLabel: To confirm, type the exact phrase:
restoreModal.help: The restore button also unlocks after 10 seconds.

factoryReset.title: Reset region data
factoryReset.description: Completely clears selected region data and restores default settings.

preserved.title: Users and roles are protected
preserved.text: Firebase Auth and the adminUsers collection are preserved. Owner, Admin, Consul and assigned access remain.

modal.title: Reset region data
modal.subtitle: Choose exactly what to clear. This action deletes data from the databases.

warning.title: This is a destructive action
warning.text: Selected data is physically deleted from the site database. It cannot be restored without a backup.

deleteAll.title: Delete all region data
deleteAll.description: Select every category below and prepare the site as a clean new region.

players.title: Players and registrations
players.description: Delete registrations, public_players and player statistics.

cycles.title: Registration cycles
cycles.description: Delete all cycle history. Players are also removed because they belong to cycles.

alliances.title: Alliances and rotation
alliances.description: Clear alliances, rotation, host alliance and governor.

registrationSettings.title: Registration settings
registrationSettings.description: Restore cycle, T9–T14, Shift 1/2/Any, form fields and public access to factory defaults.

accessRequests.title: Access requests
accessRequests.description: Delete old/pending accessRequests from Firestore without touching adminUsers.

browserData.title: Local data on this browser
browserData.description: Clear player templates, Final Plan preferences and local time settings on this device.

confirmation.label: Type the exact phrase to confirm:
confirmation.help: The delete button also stays disabled for 10 seconds.

errors.preview: Could not load the data preview.
errors.reset: Reset failed. Do not assume everything was cleared; check the Worker and try again.
errors.backup: The backup could not be downloaded, so the reset was stopped. Disable this option only if you intentionally want to continue without a backup.

factoryReset.preservedSummary: User accounts, Owner/Admin/Consul and their roles are never deleted.

backupBeforeReset.title: Download a backup before reset
backupBeforeReset.description: Before deleting, the system collects the current site data and downloads a JSON file to this device. No backup remains in the database.

access.title: Access
access.description: Control who can open the player table and final plan.
access.cycleNote: Static share links can survive across cycles but only expose published data for the current cycle.
access.publicWarning: Public mode makes current-cycle data available to everyone without a password after the next successful JSON publication. Switching modes revokes previously issued private links. Calendar-based cycle closure remains active.

duration.cycle: Until the end of the current cycle

generated.title: New access created
generated.once: Copy this link now. It becomes active after the next JSON publication; the full code is not stored in public GitHub.

messages.generated: Link created. It will work after the next snapshot publication; earlier links remain active.
messages.revoked: Link revoked. Static access will stop after the next snapshot publication.

errors.generate: Could not create the private link.
errors.noPeriod: There is no current cycle for private access.
errors.deleteLink: Could not delete the archived link.

staticLinks.title: Created links (Owner and Admin can copy saved links)
staticLinks.confirmDelete: Permanently delete this inactive link record?

sharedConsul.title: Shared consul password
sharedConsul.description: Generate a new password. The previous password and all its sessions will be revoked immediately.
sharedConsul.noWasteland: No current Wasteland end date is available.
sharedConsul.copySuccess: The consul access password has been copied to your clipboard. Share it only with trusted people.
sharedConsul.copyForeverWarning: This password does not expire. For security, generate a new one after each Wasteland, or choose one-day or until-Wasteland-ends access.
sharedConsul.multipleDescription: Up to 5 active passwords. Creating another password does not revoke existing access. Owner-only controls.
sharedConsul.limitReached: Five active passwords already exist. Revoke one or wait until one expires.
sharedConsul.passwordPrivacy: Do not share this password with untrusted people. Close this window after copying.
sharedConsul.confirmSingleRevoke: Revoke only this password? People using it will lose access. Other passwords will remain valid.
sharedConsul.confirmChangeDuration: Change this password expiration? Other passwords remain unchanged.
sharedConsul.confirmAdd: Create another password? Existing passwords will remain active.
sharedConsul.emptyActive: There are no active passwords yet.
sharedConsul.historyHint: Expired and revoked passwords appear here. You can permanently remove their records.
sharedConsul.confirmDeleteHistory: Permanently delete this record from history? Other passwords will not be affected.
sharedConsul.historyLegacy: The old password cannot be revealed. Revoke it to stop access.
sharedConsul.createHint: Up to 5 passwords may be active at once. Existing passwords remain valid.
sharedConsul.deleteBlocked: Revoke an active password before deleting it.
